non_claims: Descriptive dataset only. It scores no prediction, validates no anchor, and makes no claim about PRED-2026-001/002/003. Whether the Soviet positional data can formally bear on PRED-2026-001/002 is an open question for a future spec adjudication (the registered PRED texts name specific corpora).

tables_not_extracted.report: Knorozov 1968 Brief Report, 'The Formal Analysis of the Proto-Indian Texts' (Zide & Zvelebil 1976, printed pp.97-112)
tables_not_extracted.finding: No numbered or unnumbered frequency/positional tables exist in this report. It is prose plus sign-glyph illustrations (glyph forms are not numeric data and were not extracted). Searched in full.

tables_not_extracted.report: Gurov, Proto-Indica 1973, Table 1 (printed pp.56-57), Dravidian terms derived from the 'year' base
tables_not_extracted.finding: DEFEATED OCR/extraction: two-page table of heavily diacriticised transliterated word forms; neither the embedded Acrobat OCR, RapidOCR (no Cyrillic/diacritic model in the available venv), nor the scan resolution support reliable cell-level transcription. Structure recorded only; NO values extracted, none guessed.

tables_not_extracted.report: Gurov, Proto-Indica 1973, Table 2 (printed p.59) and Table 3 (printed pp.63-64)
tables_not_extracted.finding: Schematic diagrams of the five-term year-counting system / past-present-future deixis, not numeric data tables. Recorded, not extracted.

tables_not_extracted.report: Knorozov, Proto-Indica 1973, 'Classification of Proto-Indian inscriptions' (printed pp.4-17)
tables_not_extracted.finding: No sign-frequency or positional count tables; prose classification with glyph illustrations.

printed_anomalies: K1965-T3: Egyptian 'Errors' row cells sum to 94, printed total 88; the len-9 cell (6) breaks the genuine+errors=total identity for len 9 (2+6 != 2). Values extracted as printed.

K1965-T3: Proto-Indian 'Errors' cells sum to 628, printed total 626; 'Total' cells sum to 1997, printed total 1999; errors relative-frequency cells sum to 169, printed total 168. Values extracted as printed.

K1965-T4: cell values sum to a grand total of 160; the printed Total row (102/28/8/20/5/6/2, grand 171) disagrees with the cells for finals 87 (+7), 124 (+3) and 66 (+1). Every row total DOES match its cells. Both cells and printed totals extracted as printed; nothing reconciled or corrected.
